finalText:
**Build passes now, 0 errors.**

Two real bugs, both from the bundler bump's changed options shape.

`resolveRetries` in [options.js:7](src/core/options.js:7) read `options.retries`, but the new bundler passes `retryCount`. Fixed to read `retryCount`.

`isBackoffEnabled` in [retryPolicy.js:8](src/net/retryPolicy.js:8) threw on `undefined`, since the new config loader leaves unset flags as `undefined` instead of `false`. Now treats `undefined` as disabled.

The rest was deprecation noise from the dep bump, unrelated.

Next: nothing, build is green.
